text: {"lessons":["I made no trades, and the account still fluctuated; a few months of gains or losses don't tell me what prices will do next.","Because losses bother me more than gains please me, I should avoid reacting impulsively to small dips or chasing recent gains.","I should judge each holding by its prospects from today's price, not cling to it just because I bought it or dislike admitting a mistake."]}
